answer: The login, token and profile flow is already on your Scratch board in the frame "Login, token and profile flow (server.mjs)", so I didn't redraw it. It matches `server.mjs`: `POST /api/login` checks the password, issues `tok-<username>-<Date.now()>` into the in-memory tokens map, and returns 200 with the token and user. `GET /api/profile` looks the Bearer token up in that map and returns the username, name and email, with the password dropped. Any other route gets a 404. I can redraw it if you want a different layout.
